palette: sage museum wall + honey wood specimen frames + cream case cards + soot engraved ink + oxblood accent + brass nameplates
typography: engraved soot headings with hairline double rules, brass nameplate labels, oxblood seal chips reserved for the legal discriminator, cream case cards with soot annotations
composition: each feature is a specimen case hung on the gallery wall; forks read as branching leads inside a case; comparisons hang as three framed lanes on one rail; the coercion ladder climbs case by case toward the court doors
surface: flat sage wall with faint wainscot line, honey wood frames with mitered corners, cream mat boards, hairline engraved rules, brass corner screws; no gradients, no rounded cards, no drop shadows
motion: frames pin to the wall with a press, specimens slide from the case lining, brass nameplates engrave left to right, the ladder steps assemble bottom-up, doors swing ajar on hinge
transition: a wainscot-line wipe travels across the wall as the next case is hung
